    IHR START BEI PRAXISEINS.

    Sie haben Medizin studiert, um Patienten zu behandeln und nicht um Formulare auszufüllen, KV-Anfragen zu beantworten und IT-Ausfälle zu managen? Bei PraxisEins haben Sie ein Team hinter sich, das sich darum kümmert. Damit Sie wieder das tun können, wofür Sie angetreten sind – ganz ohne Nacht- und Wochenenddienste.

    Für unser modernes Hausarztzentrum suchen wir ab sofort einen Facharzt für Allgemeinmedizin und/oder Innere Medizin (m/w/d).

    Als inhabergeführter und staatlich unterstützter Gesundheitsversorger hat PraxisEins es sich zum Ziel gemacht, die hausärztliche Versorgung zu sichern und dabei Qualitätsmedizin zu ermöglichen!

    In unseren modernen Hausarztzentren können Sie sich ganz auf die Medizin konzentrieren. Wir legen Wert auf moderne Diagnostik, digitalisierte Abläufe, ärztliche Fortbildung, ein gutes Teamgefüge und ärztlichen Austausch im Team.

    WAS WIR IHNEN BIETEN:

    • Medizin im Mittelpunkt: Sie fokussieren sich auf die Behandlung Ihrer Patienten – den Rest übernehmen wir!

    • Qualitätsmedizin: Unsere Standorte verfügen über modernste Diagnostik und digitalisierte Praxisabläufe; ein kollegialer Austausch ist uns wichtig

    • Attraktive Vergütung und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Sie erhalten ein übertarifliches Gehalt - bei sehr guter Leistung bietet sich in unserer Gruppe die Möglichkeit des Aufstiegs zur ärztlichen Leitung mit einem attraktiven Partnerschaftsmodell

    Founders Factory × Nua Materials

    Co-Founder & CTO

    Founders Factory builds and funds new startups together with exceptional founders and leading companies. Our founding team brings its own exit and IPO experience, and since 2015 our 300+ portfolio companies have raised more than USD 900m in follow-on funding.

    For Nua Materials, we are looking for a technical Co-Founder & CTO to build a scalable product and company alongside the existing founder, starting from a validated concept.

    The opportunity

    New and more sustainable building materials already exist, yet many struggle to make the leap into real construction projects. For construction companies, housing providers and developers, information and evidence are fragmented, products are difficult to compare, and adopting unfamiliar materials creates additional technical, commercial and organisational risk. At the same time, regulatory pressure is increasing: key provisions of the revised EU Construction Products Regulation have applied since 2026, and Digital Product Passports for construction products are on the way.

    Many existing solutions focus on documentation, evidence and certification — not on the actual selection and purchasing decision. This is where Nua Materials comes in. A core component is the Nua Score, which already exists in an initial version. Conversations with manufacturers, construction companies, developers and asset owners have confirmed the need and shown interest in pilots.

    What you will build

    As Co-Founder & CTO, you will own product and technology in the early stage.

    • Define the critical workflows with users and build the first usable product.

    • Develop the Nua Score and build a robust data and system architecture across multiple external data sources.

    • Decide what to build now, what to add later, what to automate — and what deliberately should not become part of the product.

    • Work directly with early customers and partners, then build a small product and engineering team over time.

    The first months will be highly hands-on: we are looking for a technical founder who builds personally and helps shape the product, not a CTO who starts by delegating.

    Who we are looking for

    • Product development: You can turn an ambiguous customer problem into a clear, testable product approach and build it.

    • Data-driven products: You have experience with data-heavy platforms, scoring or comparison systems and can talk concretely about failure modes, data-quality issues and validation decisions you have encountered.

    • Technical range: You are strong in backend and data architecture and capable enough on the frontend to ship early product versions yourself.

    • Trust in B2B: You build transparent, credible systems that can stand up to risk-sensitive enterprise customers, long decision cycles and demanding evidence requirements.

    • Founder mindset and market understanding: You have founded before, were one of the first technical hires at a startup, or have taken on comparable ownership. Business-fluent German, professional English and experience in the DACH market are important.

    Especially relevant, but not required

    • Experience in ConTech or PropTech

    • Background in civil engineering or materials science, ideally with LCA/EPD experience

    • Experience with comparison platforms or marketplaces

    What we offer

    • Capital and founder funding for the build phase

    • Hands-on support from Founders Factory across product, data, growth, fundraising, legal, finance and talent — building on existing market, customer and product work

    • Access to early prospective customers and partners across construction and housing, as well as our international network

    Role Overview

    The Senior Security Engineer will play a central role in securing Docebo's cloud infrastructure, with a primary focus on AWS environments. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who thinks in terms of risk and moves quickly to reduce it. The role also includes participation in an on-call rotation for security incidents affecting Docebo systems.

    Responsibilities (including but not limited to):

    • Cloud Security Architecture & Hardening: Own the security posture of Docebo's AWS environments. Define and enforce secure account structures, service control policies (SCPs), guardrails, and baseline configurations across multi-account setups. Evaluate and improve network segmentation, IAM boundaries, and data protection controls. Identify and remediate misconfigurations using CSPM tooling and manual review.

    • Infrastructure as Code Security: Partner with Cloud Infrastructure to integrate security controls into IaC workflows. Define guardrails to catch insecure configurations before deployment. Own security scanning in CI/CD pipelines and promote a shift-left approach to cloud security across engineering teams.

    • Incident Response & On-Call: Participate in the on-call rotation for security incidents, including triage, containment, and escalation for after-hours events.     • Cloud Detection & Threat Monitoring: Build and maintain detection coverage for cloud-native threats (privilege escalation, unusual API activity, lateral movement, data exfiltration, and more). Leverage CloudTrail, GuardDuty, and SIEM integrations to maintain visibility across the AWS estate. Align detection logic with MITRE ATT&CK for Cloud.

    Who are we?

    Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

    We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

    We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

    We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

    Role overview:

    North is Cohere’s AI workspace platform for enterprises: a secure, customizable environment where companies can use AI across their real workflows while maintaining control over sensitive data. North connects AI agents with workplace tools, applications, and business context, helping users delegate complex work, build automations, inspect outputs, and collaborate with AI in production environments.

    As North becomes more capable, one of the most important questions is also one of the hardest: how do we know whether the model is actually getting better for the workflows customers care about?

    This role is about being the voice of North inside modelling. You will build the evaluation systems, feedback loops, and applied modelling workflows that make sure model progress translates into better product outcomes for North users. You will work closely with North product teams, customer-facing teams, and modelling teams to define what “good” means across the product surface, turn real usage and product direction into high-quality evals, and use those evals to guide model selection, patches, and regular model updates.

    This is neither a pure research role nor a conventional product engineering role. It is a rigorous applied MLE role for someone who cares deeply about measurement, model behavior, and real-world product quality. You should be excited by the craft of building careful evals: evals that capture messy agentic workflows, reflect actual customer needs, resist superficial benchmark hacking, and provide useful signal for where the product and models need to go next.

    Please note: this team works closely across Europe and East Coast North America time zones. We are open to candidates who can collaborate effectively within those hours.

    Key responsibilities:

    • Own the eval strategy for North: define what we need to measure across agent workflows, tool use, enterprise knowledge work such as deep research, document creation or editing, and other human-AI interactions.

    • Build high-quality evals from the realities of the product: user feedback, production failures, privacy-preserving usage logs, internal dogfooding, customer needs, and forward-looking product goals.

    • Create systems that continuously turn what North is learning from users, customers, and feature teams into evals, so measurement keeps pace with the product rather than becoming a static benchmark.

    • Be the voice of North inside modelling: extract clear insight from eval results, customer-derived data and product context, then turn model failures, capability gaps, and North-specific needs into actionable recommendations for the central modelling teams.

    Qualifications:

    • You have improved LLM-powered, agent-powered, or AI-product systems through evals, feedback loops, data curation, prompting, model adaptation, or model selection.

    • You care deeply about evaluation as a craft: representative tasks, precise rubrics, clean data, failure analysis, regression tracking, and knowing when a metric is giving false confidence.

    • You have strong applied MLE judgment and can reason clearly about model behavior, eval validity, product outcomes, and production tradeoffs.

    • You are comfortable working close to users and product teams, while translating messy qualitative signals into measurement that other modelling teams can act on.

    • You are self-directed, practical, and motivated by open-ended problems where the right answer requires both technical depth and product understanding.

    • You care about making AI systems genuinely useful in real enterprise settings, not just better on abstract benchmarks.

    If some of the above does not line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

    Working Location:
    This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement.     • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

      Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

      Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

    • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

    • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

    How and Where We Work:

    • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

    • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

    • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

    🎯 Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous

    Ce post-doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet ANR PRME LINEN (Experimental and Numerical Characterisation of Flax Composite Manufacturing by Liquid Infusion: From Local Phenomena to Induced Properties), auquel participent plusieurs chercheurs de l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne, avec pour objectif d’étudier l’élaboration de pièces structurales en matériaux composites à base de fibres de lin.

    Ce post-doctorat, d’une durée de 12 mois est proposé pour développer la modélisation numérique de l’infusion de résine dans des préformes composites à fibres de lin. L’objectif est d’étudier, à l’échelle mésoscopique, l’influence de l’organisation anisotrope et hétérogène des torons de fibres sur l’écoulement de la résine. Le projet s’appuiera sur des simulations 3D par éléments finis, reposant sur un couplage Stokes-Darcy et la prise en compte d’un tenseur de perméabilité orthotrope. Une attention particulière sera portée à l’influence des variations locales de la fraction volumique de fibres sur la perméabilité, les chemins préférentiels d’écoulement et les effets capillaires. Les simulations seront réalisées avec le code éléments finis Cœur (https://gitlab.emse.fr/bruchon/Coeur), en s’appuyant sur la bibliothèque PETSc et des solveurs itératifs préconditionnés adaptés aux problèmes de grande taille. Dans un premier temps, des architectures idéalisées de type unidirectionnel, quasi-unidirectionnel et tissé seront étudiées à l’aide d’une représentation par Level-Set. Dans un second temps, lorsque cela sera possible, des mésostructures réalistes seront reconstruites à partir d’images µ-CT.

    Le post-doctorant.e contribuera également au développement et à la validation de la stratégie numérique et travaillera en interaction étroite avec les travaux expérimentaux et numériques des autres tâches du projet.

    Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

    • Coordinate software and fleet upgrades with R&D and Production.

    About Mistral

    Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

    We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

    Role Summary 

    As our M&A & Equity Financing Legal Counsel, you will work directly under the Head of M&A and Finance Legal Counsel, based in Paris. In close collaboration with our Business and Finance teams, you will play a key role in structuring, drafting and negotiating Mistral’s external growth transactions and equity fundraisings.


    Mistral operates at the frontier of AI, where the pace of innovation demands transaction execution speed and precision that match the technology itself. You will help shape the growth and business relationships that will define Mistral’s next chapter.

    Key responsibilities

    • Draft, negotiate and advise on a wide range of M&A transactions, including acquisitions, acqui-hires and other internal or external growth projects worldwide.

    • Take an active part in every stage of M&A transactions: deal structuring, due diligence, negotiations, signing and closing.

    • Coordinate the process for Mistral’s equity fundraisings, including legal communication with prospective investors, structuring the company's due diligence disclosure, drafting investment documentation and leading the signing and closing of equity fundraisings.

    • Coordinate and assist on Mistral’s secondary sale transactions on behalf of investors and employees.

    • Draft, negotiate, and advise on transaction documentation, including LOIs, NDAs, SPAs, shareholders' agreements, investment agreements, and other ancillary transaction documents.

    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including other corporate functions.

    • Build internal templates, practices, and guidelines for M&A and equity financing documentation.

    • Support on other legal topics as needed, particularly on compliance matters related to corporate affairs.

    Qualifications and skills

    • Bachelor's degree or above (LLB, LLM or Juris Doctor preferred) from an accredited law school in France or another EU country. Admission to practice law in at least one additional jurisdiction, in particular the USA or the UK, would be a plus.

    • A minimum of 4–5 years of relevant legal experience, including at least 3 years at an international law firm.

    • Substantial experience in M&A, VC and/or equity financing transactions, including hands-on experience working on large- to mid-cap acquisitions, from due diligence through signing and closing.

    • Familiarity with VC/PE-type transaction documentation is highly valued: you understand complex shareholders’ agreements, management and employee incentive packages, as well as the governance dynamics of venture-backed and PE-backed companies.

    • Excellent written and verbal communication in both English and French, with a strong ability to present complex legal concepts clearly to non-legal stakeholders.

    • Knowledge and understanding of artificial intelligence technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing and their applications.

    • Adaptability: proactive, flexible, eager to learn and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

    • Ethical awareness: a strong understanding of ethical considerations related to AI, such as fairness, transparency, accountability, and bias mitigation.

    What We Offer

    We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

    For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

    We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

    At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

     

    The team

    To sustain the company's growth, Ledger is looking for a Senior Scala Backend Engineer to join the Cloud Wallet team. This team builds and operates the backend services that power blockchain account management, transaction processing and on-chain data aggregation across all Ledger wallet surfaces, from Ledger Live to Ledger Enterprise, the custody platform used by financial institutions. Every client transaction goes through these services, and so does every new blockchain Ledger supports. We believe in the power of functional programming to build robust and scalable platforms. We take time to share, challenge, and grow together through bi-weekly knowledge-sharing sessions, meetups, conferences, and open source contributions.

     

    What you’ll be doing

    • Design, build and operate the Scala services that connect Ledger wallets and the Ledger Enterprise platform to blockchain backends: account creation, operation history, transaction crafting, broadcast and lifecycle tracking.

    • Lead new blockchain integrations end to end, from the integration design (ADR) to production, across account-based, UTXO and privacy-preserving chains.

    • Own production quality on your scope: SLIs and SLOs, observability, distributed tracing. Take part in the firefighting rotation and drive incidents to resolution, including those raised by institutional clients.

    • Define clear contracts with the Coin Integration and Ledger Enterprise teams, for example where UTXO selection lives or how transaction states are exposed to consumers.

    • Write and review ADRs, challenge designs, and raise the bar on code quality, testing (including end-to-end on testnets) and technical debt management.

    • Work in an AI-native way: use coding agents daily, write the specifications, constraints and verification that let them deliver safely, and contribute to the team's AI tooling.

    • Mentor other engineers and share your knowledge across the Backend Blockchain community.

       

    You will collaborate cross-functionally with:

    • The Coin Integration team for coin modules and new blockchain integrations.

    • The Ledger Enterprise team, main consumer of the team's services for institutional custody.

    • The Ledger Wallet, Ledger Button and Wallet XP teams as consumers of the team's backend APIs.

    • The Blockchain platform team for data model alignment, indexing and event streaming.

    • The Infrastructure and SRE teams for deployment, reliability and scalability.

    • The Security team (Donjon) for vulnerability analysis and remediation.

    • The Product team for roadmap prioritization and customer-driven requirements.

     

    What we’re looking for

    • 5+ years of backend engineering, with real production ownership of distributed systems.

    • Strong production experience

    • Interest for Scala and functional programming practice

    • Hands-on blockchain integration experience: transaction lifecycle, fees, finality, reorgs, on at least two models among account-based, UTXO and privacy-preserving chains.

    • Experience with event-driven systems and data infrastructure (PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, NATS or equivalent) and with observability tooling (Datadog or equivalent).

    • Able to diagnose an incident across several services and own the outcome, from root cause to fix in production.

    • Comfortable reading and contributing to TypeScript code, as the team works on a polyglot stack.

    • Daily use of AI coding tools, with a critical eye on their output.

    • Clear written communication in English, especially for design documents and incident reports.

    • Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.

    • Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work.

    • Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.

    • Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee.

    Description

    Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes.

    You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind.


    Your mission

    1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence 

    • Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution.

    • Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy.

    • Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters.

    • Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo.

    2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership 

    • Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer.

    • Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders).

    • Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice.

    • Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos.

    3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement 

    • Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation.

    • Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations.

    • Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder.

    What We Want to Achieve Together

    In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds.

    In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount.


    Your profile

    • Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies.

    • Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences.

    • Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility.

    • Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data.

    • AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new.

    • A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough.

    • Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both.


    Why us?

    • Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else.

    • A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI.

    • Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites.

    • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation.

    • Competitive salary, based on experience and seniority.


    Process

    1. 30 min with our People & Operations Manager: cultural fit, understanding the role and your expectations.

    2. Positioning conversation with our Head of Product: bring a point of view on Legal AI and be ready to defend it live.

    3. Case study: show us something you’ve written or built, and how you’d turn it into a sales-ready asset.

    4. Meet the team in the office.

    5. Decision: if it’s mutual, we welcome you to the team!

    Our Mission

    At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

    We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

Bluprintx (BPX) is a global, AI-powered consultancy built to design and deliver the intelligent front office for CMO and CRO executives. We are private equity-backed and scaling fast, with 300 active customers across 10 countries and more than 1,750 implementations. We connect people, technology, and AI to turn fragmentation into performance, partnering with global leaders to modernize how marketing, CRM, content, AI & Data connect. What We Do: Cutting Complexity Across the Front Office

We help the world's most ambitious companies, including Uber Eats, BNY, and Xerox, untangle the operational complexity that slows enterprise growth. As a Gold Adobe Solution Partner and Salesforce Summit Partner, we deliver strategy and implementation across the full front office. Our proprietary methodology builds sustainable enabled ecosystems that maximize ROI and accelerate speed to market. By embedding AI into commercial workflows, we help clients move faster and stay ahead.

The Role

First, you'll set change management strategy at enterprise level, working directly with C-suite and senior leaders to define how their organization moves to new ways of working across marketing, sales and service. Second, you'll run the change management programs inside our largest MarTech, CRM and data transformations, from impact assessment through to measured adoption in the months after go-live.

You'll also help BPX grow, using change strategy as a lever to expand existing accounts and land new ones, and you'll shape how our change management capability develops across the global consulting team.

What you'll do

  • Set change management strategy for client organizations, aligning operating model, roles, governance and ways of working to the outcomes of a multi-year transformation roadmap.
  • Advise C-suite sponsors as a trusted, technology-agnostic voice, coaching executives on what their teams need from them at each stage and raising adoption risk early and plainly.
  • Run change programs on large MarTech transformations across Adobe, Salesforce, Braze and data platforms, owning the change workstream from impact assessment to sign-off.
  • Assess impact and readiness, mapping stakeholders, role and process changes and skills gaps, then holding go-live decisions to evidence that teams are ready.
  • Design communication, training and enablement plans for every audience, from frontline marketing and sales teams to senior leaders and centers of excellence.
  • Measure adoption and value after launch, defining the metrics, tracking usage in the live platforms and fixing what stalls early.
  • Lead workshops and design deliverables that give clients clear, practical guidance across people, process, data and technology.
  • Shape change in pre-sales, scoping approach, effort and commercial model when a transformation needs a dedicated change workstream, and spotting growth opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Build the BPX change practice, turning what works on each engagement into frameworks, templates and accelerators, and mentoring consultants across the global team.

What you'll bring

  • Ten or more years in strategy, transformation or change consulting, including several years leading change on enterprise CRM, MarTech or data programs.
  • Strategy and delivery range: a track record of both setting enterprise change strategy and running the programs that deliver it, across people, process, technology and data.
  • A proven change method such as Prosci ADKAR, ACMP standards or Kotter, applied on live client programs. Formal certification is an advantage.
  • Credibility at C-suite level, with evidence of building long-term advisory relationships and being the voice senior leaders trust when decisions get hard.
  • Large transformation experience in marketing, customer experience, digital or business transformation, working across multiple workstreams and senior governance.
  • Front office platform fluency across marketing automation, CRM, customer data platforms, journey orchestration and workflow tools, enough to know how they change someone's working day.
  • Comfort with adoption data: you define the metrics, read the dashboards and use them to decide what to fix.
  • Commercial instinct, with experience contributing to proposals, scoping and estimating work, and growing accounts through consultative selling.
  • Sector breadth across B2B and B2C. Experience in highly regulated industries such as financial services is a strong advantage.

Why this role, why now

Our clients are investing more than ever in their front office platforms, and the programs keep getting bigger. What decides whether that investment pays back is adoption, and that is where this seat sits. It's a new, senior role, so you'll set how BPX advises on change at the strategy table, how we run it on the ground, and the practice every program after yours will draw on.

Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you'll be responsible for:

Own end-to-end accounting for revenue and partner arrangements, ensuring accurate recognition, timely close, and complete disclosures across customer and partner incentives. Maintain and improve internal controls and reporting, partner with commercial, legal, tax, and data teams to define accounting and control requirements, and support internal and external audits. Identify, design, and implement AI and automation solutions — including generative models such as ChatGPT and Gemini — to reduce manual work, improve quality, and preserve human oversight and audit readiness.

What you'll work on:


  • Own month end and quarter end close for revenue and partnership arrangements, including subledger reviews, journal entries, account reconciliations, investigation and resolution of reconciling items, and related controls.
  • Analyse balance sheet and P&L movements, investigate anomalies and provide clear, evidence based commentary on key drivers, including timely review and circulation of the revenue flash.
  • Partner with FinOps and Product teams on new and evolving products, proactively reviewing product documentation and transaction and fund flows to identify accounting implications and define accounting, data, system, control and reporting requirements ahead of launch.
  • Review customer and partner arrangements and apply ASC 606 and other relevant U.S. GAAP to complex or non standard terms, documenting conclusions in clear, audit ready accounting memos.
  • Review expected credit loss provisions and underlying assumptions, ensuring estimates are appropriately supported, documented and reflected in the financial statements.
  • Partner with FinOps, Product, Billing, Legal, Tax, Data and Engineering teams to translate accounting conclusions and requirements into scalable processes, systems, controls and reporting.
  • Own the accounting for customer and partner incentives, including understanding end-to-end process and data flows, validating incentive calculations against contractual terms and supporting data, and recording appropriate accruals, true-ups, and journal entries with clear documentation and controls.
  • Take end to end ownership of assigned areas, proactively resolving issues, maintaining high quality documentation and audit readiness, and identifying AI and automation opportunities that simplify processes, strengthen controls and reduce manual work while maintaining appropriate human judgement and governance.

What you'll bring to Circle:

Core requirements:

  • 4+ years of relevant accounting, revenue or audit experience with ACA, CPA, ACCA or equivalent professional accounting qualification.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and/or IFRS, particularly ASC 606 / IFRS 15, with hands-on experience applying revenue recognition guidance to complex and judgemental arrangements.
  • Strong technical accounting and problem solving skills, with the ability to understand new products and commercial arrangements, assess their accounting implications and translate conclusions into clear accounting and system requirements.
  • Strong systems and data mindset, with the ability to understand transaction and fund flows across systems, investigate complex datasets and identify and resolve process, data or accounting gaps.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare high quality accounting memos and explain complex accounting matters clearly to Finance and non Finance stakeholders.
  • High ownership, attention to detail and quality standards, with the ability to take end to end responsibility for accounting processes, controls and audit readiness with limited oversight.
  • Hands-on experience using AI, automation or data tools to solve problems and improve processes, with a strong drive to simplify and automate work while maintaining appropriate judgement, governance and controls.

Preferred requirements:

  • Experience in payments, crypto, banking or technology companies
  • Experience with Oracle fusion or other similar ERP systems and transaction subledgers (Oracle or similar)
  • Experience/familiarity with Slack, Apple MacOS and GSuite

The Director of Worldwide Marketing Data Strategy & Analytics, you will lead the strategy, measurement frameworks, data foundations, and analytical capabilities that enable Autodesk to understand and optimize Enterprise marketing’s impact on customer and business outcomes. You will lead a global team of data strategists and analysts responsible for transforming complex data into actionable insights, predictive intelligence, and decision-support capabilities across the enterprise marketing funnel and broader go-to-market ecosystem.

This role reports to the Senior Director of Worldwide Marketing Business Insights & Analytics and plays a critical role in advancing Autodesk’s journey toward audience-centric customer experiences and data-driven commercial decision-making. Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Marketing Data & Analytics Strategy: Own the end-to-end strategy, execution, and adoption of marketing analytics, measurement frameworks, and intelligence capabilities, partnering with Marketing leadership to translate business priorities into scalable analytical solutions for Enterprise Marketing.
  • Lead a Global Analytics Team: Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing global team of data strategists and analysts, providing strategic direction, hands-on guidance, and opportunities for talent growth.

  • Establish Analytics-Ready Data Foundations: Define the business and analytical requirements for foundational marketing data structures, including data models, taxonomies, event structures, identity resolution, campaign hierarchies, and governance required to reliably connect marketing activity with customer and business outcomes.
  • Advance AI-Powered Analytics & Decisioning: Partner across Data Engineering, Data Science, Enterprise AI/ML, Marketing Technology, and Marketing to build scalable, governed capabilities that enable AI agents to generate insights, identify opportunities, recommend and optimize decisions, and orchestrate marketing actions with appropriate human oversight.

Title: Attorney 1

Overview:

IQVIA is seeking a mid-level attorney to join our corporate in-house team. Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist with public company securities law compliance and preparation of SEC filings, including 10-Ks, 10-Qs, Proxy Statements, 8-Ks, and ‘33 Act registration statements.
  • Assist with preparing materials for board and committee meetings, including drafting resolutions, consents, certificates and minutes. Assist with the annual meeting of stockholders.
  • Assist with various corporate governance initiatives relating to the company’s board of directors, including director and officer questionnaires, maintenance of corporate records, as well as review of Articles of Incorporation, Bylaws, board committee charters and other corporate governance documents and policies.
  • Assist with capital markets transactions, including debt issuances, credit facility matters, securities offerings, and related disclosure and compliance obligations, as well as ongoing compliance with debt covenants.
  • Coordinate with Sustainability team on annual Sustainability Report as well as rapidly evolving sustainability laws and disclosure requirements.
  • Assist with legal entity management, including legal entity integration and reorganization activities, creation of new legal entities, merger and consolidation of legal entities, corporate governance for joint ventures, and legal entity maintenance.
  • Participate in the development of departmental procedures to improve processes around legal entity management, corporate governance, and securities.
  • Coordinate matters handled by outside counsel.
  • Perform other duties as required.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Juris Doctorate (J.D.) degree from a nationally recognized law school and admitted to the Bar of at least one state.
  • 3-5 years of experience with U.S. public company reporting, securities law compliance, corporate governance, and capital markets transactions.
  • Strong organizational, planning, project management, communication, presentation and influence skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work creatively and with a high energy level in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships cross-functionally and across global geographies with coworkers, managers and clients.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to work simultaneously on multiple priorities.

Competitive and commensurate with experience.

What You’ll Do

  • End-to-End SaaS Delivery: Manage the full lifecycle of Cloud/SaaS implementation programs, from initial discovery to "Go-Live" and post-production support.
  • Global Team Coordination: Lead and mentor a diverse, international team of consultants and configuration specialists to ensure cohesive delivery across different time zones.
  • Stakeholder Orchestration: Act as the strategic liaison between customer executives, IT leads, and internal Veeva Product teams to manage expectations and resolve project bottlenecks.
  • Requirement & Solution Governance: Oversee business workshops to capture functional requirements while ensuring the technical design meets the holistic needs of the customer.
  • Critical Path Management: Think critically to proactively identify project risks and design mitigation strategies for challenges the customer may not yet have anticipated.
  • Data & Migration Advisory: Oversee complex data migration activities, providing expert advisory to ensure data integrity during the move from legacy systems.
  • Change Management Leadership: Drive methodologies that support customers in successfully switching from rigid on-premises systems to agile, multi-tenant SaaS solutions.

Requirements

  • Industry Leadership: 10+ years of life sciences experience, with a heavy focus on Drug Safety, Pharmacovigilance, and consulting leadership.
  • Project Management Mastery: Proven ability to lead high-impact, global system implementation programs with a high degree of customer satisfaction.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of PV processes and safety systems such as Argus, Aris, Veeva Safety
  • SaaS/Cloud Fluency: Strong understanding of the nuances of Cloud implementation, including multi-tenancy and continuous release cycles.
  • Technical Proficiency: Experience with complex safety datasets and exposure to life sciences compliance/CSV requirements.
  • Communication Excellence: Exceptional English communication skills, specifically the ability to influence and negotiate with diverse global stakeholders.
  • Solid understanding of Agile implementation methodology
  • Execution Mindset: A "roll up your sleeves" attitude with the ability to act with speed in a fast-paced environment.
  • Travel: Ability to travel approximately 25% of the time for project-related needs.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Life Sciences or Computer Science or Management

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience managing projects specifically for Veeva Vault applications.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) or Agile certification.
  • Direct experience in services delivery management or large-scale systems integration.

Perks & Benefits

  • Health Insurance fully covered for family including Employee’s parents.
  • Learning benefits to keep abreast with current market trends & keep sharpening the skill sets.
  • Work from anywhere culture which allows flexible work location.
  • Fitness benefits fully taken care by Veeva.
  • 1% Charitable giving program.

Description

Who We Are - Motivated by Purpose. Powered by Clinical Expertise.

Founded in 1983, we’re a clinically-driven, tech-enabled utilization management company offering expert clinical reviews, regulatory guidance, and actionable insights to healthcare organizations.

Excellence starts with our people.

WE OFFER

  • A competitive compensation package.
  • Benefits include healthcare, vision, and dental insurance, a generous 401k match, paid vacation, personal time, and holidays.
  • Growth and training opportunities.
  • An award-winning remote working environment.

POSITION OVERVIEW

MRIoA is seeking an experienced and strategic SDLC & Agentic Delivery Lifecycle (ADLC) Governance Lead to establish, manage, and continuously improve the enterprise software and AI delivery governance framework. This role will be responsible for defining and operationalizing standards, controls, processes, metrics, and tooling that support the successful delivery of both traditional software solutions and AI-powered applications, copilots, and autonomous agents.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong combination of software delivery governance, process engineering, audit, compliance, Agile/DevOps practices, and hands-on platform administration experience. This individual will own enterprise lifecycle governance across development teams by standardizing processes, enhancing delivery visibility, implementing quality controls, and ensuring adherence to organizational and regulatory requirements.

The role will also lead the development of an enterprise Agentic Delivery Lifecycle (ADLC) framework governing the design, deployment, monitoring, and retirement of solutions, including Generative AI, AI Agents, Copilots, and Agentic AI platforms.

Major Responsibilities or Assigned Duties

﻿Roles:

SDLC & ADLC Governance

Develop, maintain, and continuously improve enterprise SDLC and ADLC standards, policies, procedures, templates, and governance frameworks.

  • Establish lifecycle governance models supporting: Traditional application development, AI-enabled application, Copilot solutions, & Agentic AI systems / Multi-agent solutions
  • Define and manage delivery stage gates, approval processes, quality checkpoints, and governance reviews.
  • Maintain SDLC and ADLC process documentation, playbooks, standards, and reference materials.
  • Partner with development, architecture, security, QA, Product, and operations teams to ensure consistent execution of lifecycle processes.

Agentic Delivery Lifecycle (ADLC) Development

  • Lead the design and implementation of enterprise ADLC standards.
  • Define/Support governance processes for: AI use case intake and prioritization, Prompt engineering standards, Human-in-the-loop controls, Agent testing and evaluation framework, Production deployment governance, and AI observability and monitoring framework
  • Establish AI quality and evaluation frameworks including: Accuracy, Grounding, Hallucination monitoring, Reliability. Security and Responsible AI compliance
  • Develop controls for AI risk management, model traceability, and regulatory compliance.

Process Design & Continuous Improvement

  • Conduct process assessments and maturity evaluations across software delivery teams.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, reduce delivery friction, and improve engineering productivity.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives leveraging Agile, Lean, DevOps, and engineering best practices.
  • Facilitate process workshops, retrospectives, and governance reviews.
  • Lead change management initiatives supporting process adoption and organizational transformation.

Tool Administration & Platform Governance

Jira

  • Configure and maintain workflows, issue types, screens, permissions, automation rules, dashboards, and reporting structures.
  • Establish enterprise delivery and governance reporting standards.

Confluence

  • Design and maintain enterprise knowledge repositories, standards documentation, process libraries, and governance artifacts.
  • Develop templates supporting SDLC and ADLC compliance.

GitLab

  • Define and govern branching strategies, merge request standards, release management processes, and CI/CD controls.
  • Support DevOps maturity and software quality initiatives.

SharePoint

  • Administer governance repositories and documentation platforms.
  • Maintain lifecycle documentation, policies, procedures, and audit evidence.

Metrics, Reporting & Analytics

  • Develop and maintain enterprise SDLC and ADLC performance metrics.
  • Create dashboards and executive reporting to measure: Delivery predictability, Sprint effectiveness, Release frequency, Defect leakage, Change success rates, Deployment quality, Technical debt trends, Process adherence, AI adoption, Agent performance, and Responsible AI compliance
  • Analyze trends and provide recommendations to improve operational effectiveness and delivery maturity.

Audit, Compliance & Risk Management

  • Develop and execute SDLC and ADLC audit programs.
  • Conduct compliance reviews of projects, releases, and AI initiatives.
  • Assess adherence to lifecycle policies, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Identify process risks, control gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop corrective action plans and track remediation efforts.
  • Support internal and external audit activities.
  • Audit vendor performance against defined SLAs
  • Own and lead vendor SOW reviews for compliance

Requirements

Skills and Experience:

  • 8+ years of experience in SDLC governance, PMO, software engineering, DevOps, or technology delivery leadership.
  • 5+ years of experience developing and managing enterprise software delivery processes and governance frameworks.

Hands-on experience administering and configuring:

  • Jira
  • Confluence
  • GitLab
  • SharePoint

Strong understanding of:

  • Agile/SAFe
  • Waterfall
  • Hybrid delivery methodologies

DevOps and CI/CD practices

  • Experience defining KPIs, governance metrics, scorecards, and executive dashboards.
  • Experience performing process audits, compliance reviews, and maturity assessments.
  • Strong analytical, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience supporting AI, Generative AI, Copilot, or Agentic AI initiatives preferred.
  • Experience implementing governance and controls within regulated environments preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing or governing Agentic AI and Generative AI delivery processes.
  • Familiarity with:
  • Microsoft Copilot ecosystem
  • Azure AI Foundry
  • Azure OpenAI
  • LLMOps practices
  • AI governance frameworks
  • Responsible AI principles
  • Experience implementing process automation and workflow orchestration.
  • Healthcare industry experience strongly preferred.
  • Understanding of healthcare regulatory and compliance frameworks, including HIPAA and HITRUST.

﻿Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field required.
  • Master's degree preferred.

Preferred Certifications

  • PMP
  • PMI-ACP
  • SAFe Agilist
  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM)
  • ITIL Foundation
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt
  • Atlassian Certified Professional
  • GitLab Certified Professional
  • Microsoft AI certifications preferred

Work Environment:

Ability to sit at a desk, utilize a computer, telephone, and other basic office equipment is required. This role is designed to be a remote position (work-from-home).

Diversity Statement:

Diversity creates a healthier atmosphere: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

﻿

Drug-Free Workplace:

This company is a drug-free workplace. All candidates are required to pass a Background Screen before beginning employment. All newly hired employees will take a Drug Screen, as well as agreeing to all necessary Compliance Regulations on their first day of employment. Employees are required to adhere to all applicable HIPAA regulations and company policies and procedures regarding the confidentiality, privacy, and security of sensitive health information.

  • Sensitive Personal Info: MRIoA may collect sensitive personal info such as real name, nickname or alias, postal address, telephone number, email address, Social Security number, signature, online identifier, Internet Protocol address, driver’s license number, or state identification card number, and passport number.

      <title>Dremio: Software Engineer - Developer Experience</title>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Portugal - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Be Part of Building the Future</strong></h2>
<p>Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&amp;P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost.&nbsp; Learn more at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://www.dremio.com/">www.dremio.com.</a></p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p>
<p>In this role you will get opportunities to implement and maintain CI/CD systems and developer productivity solutions. You will be responsible for both regularly scheduled work as well as on-demand break-fix work to support Dremio’s CI/CD system, identifying areas of improvement, and implementing changes to increase efficiency and effectiveness of those systems.</p>
<p>Bring your industry experience to improve the efficiency and scale of Dremio’s infrastructure via innovation on tooling and methodologies. You should have empathy for developers and a passion for engineering productivity.&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Solve problems for fellow Dremio engineers by:</li>
<ul>
<li>Leveraging and contributing to playbooks to implement solutions to unblock them</li>
<li>Identifying short term workarounds and documenting them</li>
<li>Automating processes where manual processes exist.</li>
</ul>
<li>Working on infrastructure across all major clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure).</li>
<li>Managing access to key infrastructure.</li>
<li>Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and associated systems to increase organizational efficiency.</li>
<li>Automate local development workflows.</li>
<li>Analyze performance bottlenecks, root cause issues, file defects, follow up with developers, and document resolutions.</li>
<li>Clear focus on keeping our development branches ‘green’.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Release engineering - automating processes to push software to delivery endpoints.</li>
<li>Report out on the status, reliability and robustness of our CI/CD systems.</li>
<li>Actively participate in code reviews.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>B.S. or M.S in Computer Science or in a related technical field</li>
<li>1+ years of experience on large scale distributed systems</li>
<li>Comfortable navigating the fast moving, unstructured nature of a hyper-growth startup.</li>
<li>Demonstrable Knowledge and Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP)</li>
<li>Basic understanding of cloud networking and cloud architecture.</li>
<li>Proficiency in any of Java/C++/Python/Go</li>
<li>Knowledge of Maven or similar build environments</li>
<li>Hands on experience in pipeline automation using CI/CD tools like Jenkins&nbsp;</li>
<li>Experience in Infrastructure as Code</li>
<li>Experience with Terraform, BASH, Docker, Jenkins, and Kubernetes</li>
<li>Ability to write technical reports, effectively summarizing key data</li>
<li>Passion for learning and then delivering solutions using latest technologies</li>
<li>Strong Affinity for collaboration and teamwork</li>
</ul>

<p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Be Part of Building the Future</strong></h2>
<p>Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&amp;P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost.&nbsp; Learn more at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://www.dremio.com/">www.dremio.com.</a></p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p>
<p>Dremio’s Query Execution team builds the runtime responsible for executing analytical queries at scale. The team sits between query planning and table scans, owning the systems that turn query plans into efficient, reliable execution.</p>
<p>As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you’ll work on query operators, expression evaluation, memory management, execution scheduling, runtime planning, and performance optimization. Your work will directly affect query performance, scalability, and reliability across Dremio’s cloud data platform.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build the execution engine: Design, implement, test, and support query operators, expression evaluation, execution scheduling, runtime planning, and resource management.</li>
<li>Improve runtime performance: Optimize vectorized processing, concurrency, parallelism, memory usage, data exchange, and disk spilling.</li>
<li>Diagnose difficult problems: Investigate query correctness and performance issues using query profiles, profiling tools, telemetry, benchmarks, logs, and production data.</li>
<li>Optimize Java and the JVM: Improve CPU utilization, allocation behavior, garbage collection, thread behavior, and other runtime characteristics.</li>
<li>Collaborate across the query engine: Work with Query Planner, Datalake, Product, Support, and field engineering teams on end-to-end query improvements.</li>
<li>Use AI-assisted development tools: Apply AI tools to code comprehension, debugging, test generation, documentation, and incident analysis.</li>
<li>Apply engineering judgment: Validate AI-generated code and recommendations through review, testing, benchmarking, and engineering judgment.</li>
<li>Raise the engineering bar: Participate in design and code reviews, contribute to technical direction, and mentor other engineers.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Software engineering experience: 5+ years developing production software, preferably in database systems, query execution, distributed systems, or related areas.</li>
<li>Programming skills: Strong Java skills; experience with C++ is a plus.</li>
<li>Computer science fundamentals: Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, concurrency, multithreaded programming, and asynchronous programming.</li>
<li>Database and distributed systems knowledge: Understanding of database internals, query processing, distributed execution, and performance optimization.</li>
<li>Performance engineering experience: Experience profiling and optimizing CPU, memory, garbage collection, thread behavior, or other runtime characteristics.</li>
<li>Problem-solving ability: Ability to solve ambiguous technical problems and work effectively across team boundaries.</li>
<li>Engineering judgment: Ability to evaluate tradeoffs, validate solutions rigorously, and make sound decisions when working with unfamiliar or AI-assisted implementations.</li>
<li>Communication and ownership: Strong communication skills, a sense of ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality software.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Bonus points if you have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Query engines: Distributed query engines, database engines, or large-scale data processing systems.</li>
<li>Execution techniques: Vectorized execution, query operators, expression evaluation, code generation, or runtime optimization.</li>
<li>Runtime systems: JVM profiling, memory management, caching, networking, data exchange, execution scheduling, or disk spilling.</li>
<li>Data platforms: Apache Arrow, Apache Iceberg, Parquet, Avro, Spark, Hadoop, or cloud object stores.</li>
<li>Open source: Contributing to open-source projects.</li>

      <title>Toggl: Senior Full Stack</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0074/7274/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Tallinn, Estonia
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://toggl.com/jobs/">https://toggl.com/jobs/</a>
</p>

<div class="_descriptionText_5yu8i_201 ashby-job-posting-description">
<p>We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget.</p>
<p>You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product.</p>
<p>The salary for this position is&nbsp;<strong>€83,000 annually.</strong></p>
<p>You can work from anywhere in the world&nbsp;<strong>as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4.</strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2>
<p>As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes.</p>
<p>You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high.</p>
<p>Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment.</p>
<p>Your main responsibilities will be:</p>
<p><strong>Ownership and delivery</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Craft and quality across the stack</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Working with product and design</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Raising the bar</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>AI as core leverage</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>About You</strong></h2>
<p>You will thrive in this role if you:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Have deep, practical knowledge of&nbsp;<strong>JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS</strong>&nbsp;- including state management and side-effect handling in large applications.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does.&nbsp;<strong>Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast.</strong></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Nice to have:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>This Role Is NOT</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA<br>team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your<br>tests, or own your performance regressions.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>The Team</strong></p>
<p>We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself.&nbsp;<a href="https://toggl.com/culture/">Our values</a>&nbsp;fuel our results.<br><br><strong>What's Happening at Toggl</strong></p>
<p>Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger:&nbsp;<a href="https://toggl.com/focus/">Toggl 2.0</a>. One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Benefits</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Unlimited sick leave</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>€2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>€3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>€4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>€2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair)</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-senior-full-stack">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-senior-full-stack</a></p>
</description>

      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6433/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Minnesota
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.steuartnutrition.com/">https://www.steuartnutrition.com/</a>
</p>

<p><strong>About us</strong></p>
<p>Steuart Nutrition is a GMP-certified contract manufacturer making powders, liquids, capsules and stick packs for growing wellness brands. We run on Extreme Ownership, clear communication and fast turnaround, and we want a developer who works the same way.</p>
<p><strong>The role</strong></p>
<p>We're hiring a remote developer to own the customization of our training app. You'll learn the platform quickly, then build what our teams need to train and onboard people. Over time you'll also take on other internal tools and automations. AI-assisted development is central to how we work, so we want someone who uses AI tools to write and ship better code faster.</p>
<p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Learn our training app inside and out, then customize and extend it</li>
